featured_reviews.name: Joshua Mendes
featured_reviews.review_text:
If you're looking for a place to learn swimming, I would highly recommend Rose Delight. This is more like a community driven project. There’s a real "family vibe" here that puts you at ease the moment you walk in.

The trainers—Paul, Daniel and the larger team—are fantastic. They have a massive amount of patience and a clear love for what they do, especially when it comes to teaching kids.

I have personally seen my 7yo son go step by step and learn swimming in just a few sessions.

Paul and team really take huge efforts and patience to train the technical stuff like breathing, floating, and building up stamina so you don't get tired out.

It’s a great spot for both adults and children to learn. It’s rare to find a place that cares this much about the people they are teaching. If you want to learn swimming in a supportive, loving, and professional setting, this is the perfect place to dive in! 🏊🏼‍♂️

featured_reviews.review_text: We were nervous when our daughter started swimming lessons, but Coaches  made the experience comfortable and enjoyable. The coaches are very supportive, specially coach caleb coach daniel and coach joshua  for encouraging my daughter and very good and kind with her .Their patience, discipline, and ability to build confidence in the water have made a huge difference. We’ve seen remarkable improvement in swimming technique, stamina, and overall enthusiasm for the sport.”Highly recommended!”

featured_reviews.name: Raj Gupta
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently completed my 15-day swimming course at "Rose Delight Swimming Club", and the experience was excellent.

I started as a beginner, but thanks to the effective coaching, I can now swim with absolute confidence.

It was also the perfect way for kids who were attending the swimming sessions to utilize their summer vacation.

At the same time, we working professionals also had the great advantage of learning to swim and refreshing ourselves before we start our day!

I was amazed to see how each and every trainer was always on their toes for each of us coming there.

It clearly showed their true passion to ensure that everyone learns effective swimming.

They genuinely wanted whosoever joined their class to become a confident swimmer.

And kudos to the whole team for their rigorous effort and dedication!

Highly recommended!

featured_reviews.name: Cleta Fernandes
featured_reviews.review_text:
Me and my son had a wonderful experience learning swimming at Rose Delight Swimming club.
It was a very pleasant experience with no pressure, calm and clear instructions. Step by step ahead and on day 3 I was already floating and swimming. Couldn't believe my progress. Being scared of water from childhood it was really an overwhelming experience.
For my son learning swimming was something really new and instead of rough experience with water we wanted him to enter and learn with calm and peace and be friends with water. And this ended up being exactly the place we were looking for. My son is confident to swim on his own now. My son got the fear of drinking water from the pool and the way it was handled by Paul Sir was really commendable. No pressure no stress, the base of teaching is understanding the students capability and handling the fears.
The enormous patience that Paul Sir and Daniel Sir have shown is hats off. Great support by all team at Rose Delight Swimming club.

featured_reviews.name: Aarav Matiwala
featured_reviews.review_text: Paul and his team of trainers are highly trained. Our 7 year old learnt to swim in less than 2 weeks. Their patience and gaging a child’s potential is commendable. Our little one is anxiously looking forward to their next swimming batch.

featured_reviews.name: Snehal Dias
featured_reviews.review_text: We had an excellent swimming experience for our kids, Emily and Ezekiel. The fear and hesitation they initially had around swimming completely disappeared after joining Rose Delight Swimming Class. The coaches are extremely patient, professional, and dedicated, providing personalized attention according to each child's skill level and confidence. Their encouraging teaching approach helped both children feel safe, comfortable, and motivated in the water. It has been wonderful to see their progress, confidence, and enthusiasm grow with every session. We truly appreciate the care and commitment shown by the entire team. We highly recommend Rose Delight Swimming Class to any parent looking for a safe, supportive, and effective environment for their children to learn swimming and develop lifelong water confidence.

featured_reviews.name: Vimal Chandran
featured_reviews.review_text:
I've visited this swimming pool twice as a guest, paying ₹300 per session as Guest , and overall, I enjoyed my time there. As a beginner who can float and manage short laps with breaks, I found the environment quite welcoming. The infrastructure is solid — the pool is clean, and the changing areas are decent and well-maintained.

However, I found the membership process quite confusing and somewhat unfair. The monthly membership fee is around ₹1500, which is reasonable — but to qualify, one must pass a swimming test that requires completing short lap in a single go without stopping. If you don’t pass, the only option offered is coaching, which costs ₹5000 for 22 sessions. These sessions must be completed within 26 days, despite the pool being closed 4 days each month. There are no extensions allowed, even in cases of illness or work-related commitments, which makes it difficult for working professionals or those with unpredictable schedules.

What feels particularly odd is that guest entry requires no test at all, yet someone who is genuinely trying to improve by opting for membership or coaching is held to a strict and inflexible system. There’s also a lack of clarity on what exactly is covered in the coaching sessions — something that should definitely be communicated more transparently given the cost and time constraints.

To whoever manages or owns this facility, I sincerely request you to reconsider these policies. A more flexible, beginner-friendly approach would not only help more people learn and improve their swimming skills but also create a more positive and inclusive experience overall.
